items.title: Pay invoice for electrical work
items.quote: Zahlbar innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: Period start: invoice date 20.03.2026 (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, day of the event not counted). 14 days later would fall on 03.04.2026, which is Good Friday 2026 (a nationwide public holiday). The following days, 04.04. (Sat), 05.04. (Sun) and 06.04. (Easter Monday, also a nationwide holiday), are likewise non-working. Per § 193 BGB the due date moves to the next working day: Tuesday 07.04.2026. This is a payment to a private company, so the payer's own Land (NW) holidays apply, which include the nationwide holidays used here.
